verdict.rationale: Publishing plain-language, step-by-step guidance is a fair question for a government e-services portal like e-FRRO, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a script-only application shell at the root (12 characters of text) and a 404 at the long-published entry path. Nothing shows that any explainer or guidance content is published.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes plain-language, step-by-step guidance for my task — explainers a non-lawyer can follow, not just statute text and form numbers
